subject.title: feat(ui): redesign cron page as sidebar-first Automations master-detail

question: Should a stored `['overview']` sidebar pin list be migrated to include Automations even though it may represent an intentional Overview-only customization?
rationale: The existing settings record has no default-version or customization marker, so universal upgrade adoption and perfect preservation of identical user intent cannot both be guaranteed.

options.title: Migrate exact old default
options.body: Treat stored `['overview']` as the prior generated default and add `cron`, accepting that an intentional identical customization will also change.

options.title: Apply to fresh users only
options.body: Preserve every valid stored list and revise the user-impact claim so default pinning applies only to fresh or reset settings.

options.title: Add future provenance
options.body: Version sidebar defaults or persist customization state, while leaving ambiguous existing records unchanged.

recommendation.title: Migrate exact old default
recommendation.body: Treat stored `['overview']` as the prior generated default and add `cron`, accepting that an intentional identical customization will also change.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent sidebar and Cron direction plus the linked feature proposal make this person the clearest owner of the upgrade-policy tradeoff.
